title: Fusian: Multi-LoRA Fusion for Fine-Grained Continuous MBTI Personality Control in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2603.15405v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities in simulating diverse human behaviors and personalities. However, existing methods for personality control, which include prompt engineering and standard Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), typically treat personality traits as discrete categories (e.g., "Extroverted" vs. "Introverted"), lacking the ability to precisely control the intensity of a trait on a continuous spectrum. In this paper, we introduce Fusian, a novel framework for fine-grained, continuous personality control in LLMs. Fusian operates in two stages: (1) Trajectory Collection, where we capture the dynamic evolution of personality adoption during SFT by saving a sequence of LoRA adapters, effectively mapping the continuous manifold of a trait; and (2) RL-based Dynamic Fusion, where we train a policy network using Reinforcement Learning to dynamically compute mixing weights for these frozen adapters. By

translated_title: Fusian：面向大语言模型中MBTI人格细粒度连续控制的多LoRA融合方法
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）在模拟多样化的人类行为和人格方面已展现出令人印象深刻的能力。然而，现有人格控制方法，包括提示工程和标准的监督微调（SFT），通常将人格特质视为离散类别（例如“外向”与“内向”），缺乏在连续谱上精确控制特质强度的能力。本文提出了Fusian，一个用于LLM细粒度连续人格控制的新型框架。Fusian分两个阶段运行：（1）轨迹收集，通过保存一系列LoRA适配器来捕捉SFT过程中人格形成的动态演变，从而有效映射人格特质的连续流形；（2）基于强化学习的动态融合，使用强化学习训练一个策略网络，动态计算这些冻结适配器的混合权重。
tldr: Fusian框架通过在SFT过程中收集LoRA适配器轨迹序列，并利用强化学习训练策略网络动态融合这些冻结适配器，实现了对大语言模型MBTI人格特质强度的细粒度连续控制。
en_tdlr: Fusian enables fine-grained continuous control of MBTI personality trait intensity in LLMs by collecting LoRA adapter trajectories during SFT and dynamically fusing these frozen adapters through a reinforcement learning-trained policy network.
